M/s Voltas  Vs. Satish Gupta
Civil Appeal No. 226 of  2024
CNR No. CHCH01-002878-2024
Present : Sh. Sanjay Judge, Advocate for the appellant
    Ms. Bhavik Mehta and Sh. S K Chhabra, counsel for the 
 
    respondent
   Written arguments on behalf of respondent placed on record.
     Arguments heard.
   Vide separate detailed judgment of even date, the instant appeal
stands dismissed, as detailed therein. Decree sheet be prepared. Record of
the trial Court be returned to the concerned quarter and after due
compliance, file of this Court be consigned to record room.
    (Ashwani Kumar)
Pronounced.
 
 Additional District Judge,
14.08.2025
 Chandigarh.  UID No.HR0106 
Seema Bura, Stenographer II
